title: TramTracker 2088 — Melbourne Yarra Trams 3D Simulator
description: A complete, production-ready interactive 3D Melbourne tram simulator in vanilla HTML/CSS/ES6, rendered with Three.js r128 and simulated with Cannon.js 0.6.2, with chase and first-person driver's cab views.

build.includes: Initial build, track-spin fix and driver's cab view

tokens.note: Snapshot from the OpenCode session record at 2026-11-01T18:34:27Z. total = input + output + reasoning. Cache reads/writes are context-usage figures and are reported separately rather than added to the model-token total.

cost.note: As reported by the OpenCode session record.

features: Procedural Melbourne city grid with Swanston Street and Flinders Street
Flinders Street Station façade with copper dome and clock tower
Federation Square deconstructivist shards, plaza, screen and amphitheatre
Yarra River, Princes Bridge, Southbank skyline and Melbourne University
Embedded steel rails, concrete sleepers and full overhead catenary
W-Class / Cyber-Tram 2088 with Cannon.js rigid body and rail physics
First-person driver's cab view with drag-to-look, speed FOV, head sway and rain wipers
Keyboard and touch traction/brake controls, orbit camera and recentre
Four stops with waiting passengers and animated Myki boarding
Synthesised Myki beeps, wheel screech, rail clatter, rain and thunder
Hook Turn Challenge mini-game with live trams, bikes, signals and collisions
Instant sunny, rain and twilight weather presets
localStorage career save plus tramtracker_save.json export/import
Nine route badges and career statistics
Responsive glassmorphic Yarra green/gold + neon UI

revisions.change: Fixed a 360° tram spin at track corners by removing duplicate straight/arc control points and stabilising heading sampling with a short chord.
Added a first-person driver's cab view (V) with cockpit overlay, drag-to-look, curve lean, speed-reactive FOV and animated rain wipers.

checked: 377 m Swanston Loop with four named stops and 20 waiting passengers
49-part tram mesh and 12,000 kg Cannon body
Flinders Street Station, Federation Square, Yarra River and catenary
Web Audio voices and three weather presets
Nine badges, minimap, HUD and save/load wiring
Traction simulation and live Myki boarding
Driver's cab view switching, camera FOV and orbit-control handoff
verification.screenshots: Desktop 1600×1000 and mobile 390×844 captured from the live build with headless Chrome (SwiftShader WebGL).
